name: Coloured Noise
description: A held key opens one bed of noise, from white through pink to brown, with low and high cuts. Keys can tint it with a faint pitch, and a slow drift keeps it moving.

params.name: Colour
params.description: Slope of the noise. At 0 it is white and hissy, in the middle pink and even, at the top brown and deep. The level stays the same.

params.name: Low cut
params.description: Removes what lies below this pitch, steeply. Raise it to keep a deep colour from rumbling.

params.name: High cut
params.description: Removes what lies above this pitch, steeply. Lower it for a darker, softer bed.

params.name: Tint
params.description: Adds a soft ringing band at the pitch of each held key, so the noise takes on a faint chord. At 0 the keys only open the bed.

params.name: Drift
params.description: Depth of a slow, irregular swell: now and then the bed sinks and darkens, then comes back. At 0 the noise is steady.

params.name: Drift time
params.description: Average length of one swell. Each swell is longer or shorter than the last by up to half, so the bed never keeps a beat.

params.name: Width
params.description: At 0 both sides carry the same noise. At 1 each side has its own, widest on headphones. Speakers blend the two, and a mono fold is as loud at any setting.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long the bed takes to fade in after a key goes down.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long the bed takes to fade out after the last key is let go.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the whole instrument.

origin.note: Written for the beat and breath family on cpp/kit/colour.h and the Ears law of cpp/kit/beat.h.
